rejectedInferenceArchitectures.direct_1024: catastrophic final geometry fragmentation in E1

dataPolicy.engineeringCanary: TF-PW32 may validate code but cannot support a clinical claim

canarySchedule.advanceRule: advance only after every registered global, regional, topology and raw-geometry repeatability gate passes

E3-B-step50.correctedDiagnosis: raw geometry is repeatable; rejection remains independently required by regional anatomy and welded topology regressions

E4-initial-task-vector-screen.nextPermittedAction: pre-register a smaller fixed alpha bracket and screen all four tooth families

E4-four-family-refinement.diagnosis: post-hoc reduced-precision task-vector scaling is discontinuous and does not reliably constrain occupancy across tooth families
E4-four-family-refinement.nextPermittedAction: training-time full-precision trust-region regularization with a bounded smoke and parameter-drift gate

E5-training-time-parameter-trust-region.method: FP32-master hard relative-L2 projection after every optimizer step; BF16-autocast forward/backward
E5-training-time-parameter-trust-region.diagnosis: a small global parameter-space displacement does not guarantee stable sparse occupancy across tooth families
E5-training-time-parameter-trust-region.nextPermittedAction: pre-register an output-space teacher-consistency constraint on frozen base sparse predictions, then qualify with a two-step smoke before any longer training

E6-unit-weight-teacher-consistency.method: frozen pinned-base teacher on the identical noisy latent, timestep and image condition
E6-unit-weight-teacher-consistency.diagnosis: unit-weight consistency was approximately three orders of magnitude smaller than the supervised term and did not preserve incisor occupancy
E6-unit-weight-teacher-consistency.nextPermittedAction: pre-register scale-normalized consistency with a frozen family-balanced anchor batch; run a two-step loss-ratio smoke before any 10-step canary

E7-scale-normalized-anchor-consistency.method: detached per-step loss-scale calibration targeting a 10% teacher-consistency contribution on a frozen eight-asset anchor with two teeth per family
E7-scale-normalized-anchor-consistency.diagnosis: a globally calibrated teacher-output loss can be numerically active while still permitting severe family-specific sparse-occupancy drift
E7-scale-normalized-anchor-consistency.nextPermittedAction: pre-register a direct sparse-occupancy preservation objective with family-specific normalization or sampling; prove gradient and occupancy behavior in a two-step incisor-focused smoke before any longer run

E8-decoded-occupancy.method: frozen sparse decoder supervision on reconstructed clean sparse latents using BCE-with-logits plus soft Dice, detached dynamic calibration to 10% of supervised MSE
E8-decoded-occupancy.diagnosis: decoded occupancy supervision at arbitrary diffusion timesteps is technically active but does not preserve the inference occupancy boundary for incisors or premolars
E8-decoded-occupancy.nextPermittedAction: run a no-optimizer family-by-timestep gradient diagnostic and persist immutable base occupancy coordinates before registering any E9 training objective

E9-decoded-occupancy-gradient-diagnostic.method: zero-update family-by-timestep autograd diagnostic against the pinned frozen sparse decoder; compare supervised flow-MSE and decoded occupancy gradients
E9-decoded-occupancy-gradient-diagnostic.diagnosis: meaningful decoded occupancy at t=0.05-0.5 produces an excessive auxiliary-to-supervised gradient ratio; the only globally gradient-safe point, t=0.95, has near-zero occupancy Dice and is not meaningful anatomical supervision
E9-decoded-occupancy-gradient-diagnostic.nextPermittedAction: move away from direct sparse decoded-occupancy supervision; pre-register and qualify a shape-stage or latent-consistency objective with an explicit semantic-validity gate before any optimizer run

stoppingRules: stop on any crown or root regional regression
stop on any tooth-family median regression
stop on validation divergence or non-finite optimization
never continue merely because training loss falls
